title: Profile > About Yap Wei Jun
text: Yap Wei Jun is a Singapore-based software engineer building browser-native tools and local-first AI workflows. His public website describes him as focused on frontend tools and AI lab-style projects.

title: Profile > Background
text: His public GitHub profile describes him as a junior software engineer in Singapore with 3+ years building ERP and business applications using Lucee (CFML), PHP, JavaScript, and PostgreSQL/MySQL. His public work also highlights browser-side tools, QR generators, file utilities, and client-side media tooling.

text: Based in Singapore.

title: Profile > Philosophy
text: His public positioning emphasizes practical, lightweight tools that run directly in the browser without heavy server dependencies. The recurring themes across the website and public repos are simplicity, performance, direct utility, and browser-first implementation.

title: Projects > QR Code Generator
text: The public website includes a QR Code Generator tool at `yapweijun1996.com/tools/QR-Code-Generator/index.php`. The tool supports QR styling controls such as shape, color, border style, center style, logo upload, and export to PNG or SVG.

title: Projects > PayNow QR Generator
text: The public GitHub repository `yapweijun1996/PayNow-QR-Generator` describes a web application that generates PayNow QR codes from payment details such as UEN, amount, expiry date, reference number, and company name. The README also mentions optional logo support and a GitHub Pages demo.

title: Projects > ScreenClip Pro
text: The public repository `yapweijun1996/Screen-Recorder-React-JS-Frontend` describes ScreenClip Pro as a browser-side screen recorder and editor. It can capture a display, trim the result, and export MP4 entirely on the client using React, Vite, and FFmpeg.wasm.

title: Projects > WiFi QR Code Generator
text: The public repository `yapweijun1996/WiFi-QR-Code-Generator` describes a web application that generates WiFi QR codes from SSID, password, and encryption type, allowing mobile devices to join a network by scanning the generated code.

title: Projects > Dropbox Link Converter
text: The public repository `yapweijun1996/Dropbox-Link-Converter` describes a small web app that converts standard Dropbox sharing links into direct download links and provides one-click clipboard copy support.

title: Projects > Public Project Themes
text: Across the website and public repositories, the recurring project themes are browser-native utilities, QR and sharing tools, client-side media processing, and lightweight web applications built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related frontend tooling.

title: Services > What Yap Wei Jun Offers
text:
### AI Application Development
Custom AI-powered web applications built with modern LLMs (Gemma, Gemini, Claude, GPT). Specializing in browser-native solutions that do not require heavy backend infrastructure.

### Full-Stack Development
End-to-end web application development using JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and modern frameworks. Experience with both frontend and backend systems.

### Technical Consulting
Consulting on AI integration, LLM tooling, prompt engineering, and browser-based automation. Helping businesses adopt AI tools effectively.

### Custom Tool Building
Building specialized tools and browser extensions for automation, data processing, and workflow optimization.

text:
